purpose: Eligibility and identity freeze before any effect analysis or model fitting. Final protocol supplements with actual manifests; does not restore unseen status.

qualification.endpoint: IC50; pChEMBL exact finite, source SQL standard_relation = and nM; retain source minimal curation
qualification.value_identity: Decimal numeric string equality; never round distinct values together
qualification.conflicts: exclude canonical (assay,compound) key and all related edges when >1 distinct reported value; check Final and relevant same-key source cache values
qualification.identity: RDKit 2025.03.5 sanitized canonical isomeric SMILES, preserve tautomer, formal charge, isotope and stereo; no neutralization or tautomer canonicalization. A single carbon-containing fragment may retain identity after removing only carbon-free disconnected counterions. Multiple carbon-containing fragments or ambiguous same-ID normalized structures excluded. No largest-organic-fragment picking.
qualification.pair: authors original analogue edges only, undirected canonical IDs once; no effect-direction or magnitude filtering
qualification.assay_metadata: only existing assay IDs official ChEMBL API; no activity endpoint; preserve returned API version/date; target mismatches exclude
qualification.canonical_id: lexicographically smallest original CHEMBL ID for identical normalized isomeric SMILES
qualification.cache_scope: structure and consistency validation only for Final compound IDs and Final (assay,raw compound) keys; no extra observations added

grouping.components: all eligible unique observation records before task-count/query filters; retain groups of ineligible tasks
grouping.id: lexicographically smallest assay ID in each component
grouping.split: numpy.random.default_rng(20261031).permutation(sorted group IDs); floor(.70 G) dev, floor(.15 G) val, rest eval; no retry
grouping.unknown_source: missing DOI and document ID flagged, not independent literature

c8.fingerprint: Morgan radius2 2048 bits, includeChirality false (identity still preserves stereo)
c8.iteration: maximin Tanimoto distance to selected, tie minimum ID

task.query: original unique edges both ends outside C8; point-level unique nodes of these edges; no query => excluded, no reference replacement
task.statistics: edge reciprocal-degree weight normalized task, equal tasks per group, equal final groups; fixed direction only

no_outcome_view_before_freeze: Qualification code reads values to validate exactness/conflicts; only aggregate eligibility counts shown, no query values or differences inspected. Cache opcode introspection incident separately logged.
hard_stop: If prescribed identity/source groups fail run gate, no model fits or effect analysis; deliver exact coverage and reusable task implementation, no repartition or relaxation.
stage: Qualification complete; scientific definitions frozen before preprocessing and predictive fitting

hypotheses.H1: Fixed Tanimoto residual kernel D improves held-out group-weighted analogue selection loss beyond validation-selected A-C no-structure calibration
hypotheses.H2: Full conditional deep kernel I improves over H without assay conditioning; predictive information contrast, not causal assay mechanism

B.name: affine
B.objective: sum squared centered standardized residuals + lambda*(slope-1)^2

B_aux.name: isotonic
B_aux.increasing_or_decreasing: minimum C8 squared error; ties increasing

E.name: rf
E.weights: each task total1; each episode equal; unique non-context nodes equal

F.name: fscap
F.adaptation: separate query/context encoders, context fingerprint multiplied by target standardized value, mean aggregation; append source value, common target and assay descriptions; predict residual around common affine
F.normalization: per-layer batch norm in encoders, none in predictor
F.note: compact task adaptation; preserves original multiplication/context aggregation, not published benchmark reproduction

G.name: actfound
G.backbone: official FCNReLUNormNetworkQSAR, two hidden2048 stages, per-step batchnorm/leakyReLU and bias-free scalar head
G.adaptation: append standardized source potency, common target name, source/target metadata; Tanimoto computed ONLY on original Morgan bits; native target units
G.native_objective: sqrt(.25 robust query-pair error + .5 robust context-query error + point prediction MSE); nearest half by original fingerprint, embedding-softmax temperature.2
G.guard: skip update if support loss >=10 times initial support loss; count attempted/applied steps
G.inference_scale: max(.2, unbiased SD of8 context target values), native rule
G.reset: fresh saved initialization every task; evaluation once per task/seed/best

H.name: no_condition
H.assay_condition_inputs: replace assay vector by trainable task-invariant vector; same nominal modules and widths
H.shared_target_information: same target-name encoding and development-ID/UNK embedding as I

I.name: conditional
I.condition: small FiLM linear map; no auxiliary modules/losses

preprocessing.potency_scale: unique eligible development observations mean/populationSD, common source/target scale
preprocessing.text: TFIDF unigram/bigram max20000, SVD min(128,rank dimensions), random_state20261031; fit development assay descriptions and target names only
preprocessing.structured: official categorical assay fields, unknown handling and explicit masks; no inferred substrate/time/temperature
preprocessing.ID_features: assay/document/DOI forbidden; common target ID/name same in all learned models

global_training.task_sampling: each development task once per epoch, shuffled by seed; context/query uniformly sampled without replacement from eligible unique participants
global_training.selection: best validation task-equal MAE; first epoch wins exact tie; last archived not selected
global_training.kernel_grid: same saved best model, inference lambda grid only, no retraining; validation group-equal L picks configuration once
global_training.device: CPU torch2.5.1+cpu, at most4 threads; no visible GPU
global_training.timing: first official job is benchmark, no hidden pilot fit

validation_selection.common_affine_lambda: validation group-equal L, grid order breaks ties
validation_selection.per_kernel: validation group-equal L, fixed grid order ties

evaluation.two_step: freeze best checkpoints, chosen hyperparameters/comparators, rules and metrics; then open evaluation C8 only to prediction program and hash all query predictions; only then score query target values
evaluation.prediction_tie: absolute predicted difference<=1e-8 choose smaller canonical compound ID
evaluation.L: max(target A,target B)-target of predicted higher-potency choice
evaluation.aggregation: equal tasks per final group, equal final groups; calculate perseed then average seed metrics

bootstrap.scope: fixed fitted models; not training/selection uncertainty

auxiliary: observed reversals both gaps>=.3; only .6 sensitivity
evaluation.reverse_direction: supplementary definition only, not an independent task or additional fits in main budget

rules.formation: development/validation only, source gap/structural bridge coverage/C8 residual heterogeneity/available assay conditions; not query outcomes at inference

strict_structure_sensitivity.trigger_before_evaluation: H1 family interval upper<0 and >=10% relative L decrease, OR model-line continuation criteria all met
strict_structure_sensitivity.procedure: remove training records with same nonempty Murcko as evaluation query; same evaluation queries/C8 and models/hyperparameters; recheck100dev/30eval final-group gate; no repartition
strict_structure_sensitivity.allowance: 8 extra neural and2 RF, no restarts; CPU16h/GPU32h

decision.model_continue: I at least10% relative L improvement over bestA-H, family interval upper<0; I-H family interval upper<0; both seed differences negative, meaningful absolute effect
decision.knowledge_continue: fixed D supports H1 AND frozen conditions have useful held-out predictive/selection value beyond generic interpolation/small-gap/common errors
decision.otherwise: contract or stop; no model/seed/partition/source expansion; JCIM target retained
